title: Counter application
summary: Control a counter with a configurable step and explicit reset.

quiz.question: Why is a functional updater useful for incrementing this counter?
options: It calculates from the pending previous count
quiz.explanation: Queued updates compose instead of reading an older snapshot.

title: Interactive profile card
summary: Edit a profile preview through controlled inputs.

quiz.question: Which value is the source of truth for the profile preview?
options: A second hidden copy in the preview
quiz.explanation: Controlled fields and the preview derive from the same object state.

title: Digital clock
summary: Display real browser time with timezone and clock-format controls.

quiz.question: What must happen when the clock unmounts?
options: Write the time into a global variable
quiz.explanation: The Effect cleanup releases the timer so it does not keep updating an absent component.

title: Todo application
summary: Create, complete, filter, and remove browser-local tasks.

quiz.question: Which key preserves a task identity after filtering?
options: A new random number on each render
quiz.explanation: An ID belongs to the task, while an index belongs to its current position.

title: Quiz application
summary: Practice state and JavaScript with immediate explanations.

quiz.question: Why lock the selected answer until moving to the next question?
options: To keep feedback and scoring consistent for that attempt
quiz.explanation: Each question has one recorded selection; retry deliberately clears the attempt.

title: Expense tracker
summary: Track expenses in integer cents and inspect category totals.

quiz.question: Why does this tracker store integer cents?
options: To keep ordinary currency arithmetic in integer units
To convert every amount to dollars
To hide amounts from the browser
quiz.explanation: Parsing validates decimal input once, then totals use integer cents before display formatting.

title: Searchable student directory
summary: Search, filter, and sort a local student dataset.

quiz.question: When should the directory filter its dataset?
quiz.explanation: Filtering derives a view while preserving the source dataset.

title: Weather dashboard
summary: Explore deterministic weather fixtures with realistic async states.

quiz.question: What should a canceled weather request do to the visible error state?
options: It should not report a user-facing request failure
It must show a red error
It must clear all city options
quiz.explanation: Cleanup aborts obsolete requests; cancellation is a change of intent, not a failed observation.

title: Movie discovery interface
summary: Discover a fictional local movie catalog and keep a watchlist.

quiz.question: What should the watchlist persist?
quiz.explanation: IDs identify movies across sorting and filtering without duplicating the whole catalog.

title: Notes application
summary: Create, edit, search, and delete browser-local notes.

quiz.question: What happens when an existing note is saved?
options: Replace the matching ID with a new object
quiz.explanation: Editing retains identity while replacing the stored record immutably.

title: Shopping cart
summary: Manage quantities and derived totals for a local product catalog.

quiz.question: Where should the cart subtotal come from?
options: Product prices multiplied by current quantities
quiz.explanation: A derived total stays consistent after add, quantity change, remove, and clear.

title: React Router dashboard
summary: Navigate nested dashboard views with shareable search parameters.

quiz.question: Why use the URL for the directory query?
options: A bookmark can reproduce the filtered view
It makes the filter a secret
It replaces validation of route IDs
quiz.explanation: URL-driven state supports history and sharing; missing records still need a not-found branch.

title: CRUD management interface
summary: Maintain a small local inventory with validated create and edit workflows.

quiz.question: What distinguishes an update from a create?
options: Whether the save button is green
quiz.explanation: Existing IDs select a record to replace; new records receive a new ID.

title: Paginated data explorer
summary: Explore mock async data with search, pagination, and explicit failure controls.

quiz.question: What happens to the current page when the search changes?
options: Reset or clamp it to a valid page
quiz.explanation: Filtering precedes pagination, so the number of pages can shrink.

title: Registration system
summary: Complete a two-step locally simulated enrollment with accessible validation.

quiz.question: Where should form values live across review and back navigation?
options: Only in the unmounted field DOM
quiz.explanation: The state owner remains mounted while the visible step changes.

title: Admin analytics dashboard
summary: Filter sample learning activity, calculate metrics, and export the visible data.

quiz.question: What data should an exported CSV contain?
options: The same filtered records as the visible report
quiz.explanation: Export and rendering share the same derived dataset so the report is reproducible.

title: E-commerce frontend
summary: Browse products and complete a validated simulated checkout.

quiz.question: Does the checkout in this project process a real payment?
options: No, it confirms a labeled local simulation
quiz.explanation: A real payment requires a trusted service and a documented transaction flow.

title: Learning management interface
summary: Enroll in sample courses and track individual lesson completion.

quiz.question: What identifies one completed sample lesson?
options: The course ID and lesson position within that fixed sample
quiz.explanation: Completion must identify which lesson within which course it belongs to.

title: Project management board
summary: Manage tasks through a keyboard-friendly three-column workflow.

quiz.question: Why are native selects used to move tasks?
options: They provide a keyboard-operable move action
They eliminate the need for state
quiz.explanation: A board need not depend on pointer-only drag-and-drop to implement its workflow.

title: Real-time UI simulation
summary: Inspect a local event stream with pause, filtering, and cleanup.

quiz.question: What produces events in this project?
options: A local timer explicitly labeled as simulation
quiz.explanation: The effect starts/stops a local timer and keeps a bounded event history.

title: Accessible component library
summary: Explore keyboard-operated tabs, a native modal, and disclosure patterns.

quiz.question: After closing a dialog, where should focus usually return?
options: To the control that opened it
quiz.explanation: Restoring trigger focus preserves a predictable keyboard workflow.

title: Production-style SaaS dashboard
summary: Manage a fictional workspace, seats, and sample invoices locally.

quiz.question: Does changing a local team role enforce real authorization?
options: No, this is a local demonstration
Yes, hiding a button is sufficient
quiz.explanation: Trusted services must enforce real access; this frontend does not send invitations or change permissions.

title: StudyFlow capstone
summary: A complete local study planner with routing, validated tasks, a real fixture fetch, persistent reducer state, and a strict TypeScript edition.
features: Fetch API, cancellation, loading, empty and error states
Local reducer persistence and JSON export

quiz.question: Why validate a course response at runtime even in TypeScript?
options: Types do not validate unknown JSON after compilation
Fetch always returns a valid Course array
quiz.explanation: The API adapter checks the external shape before returning data to typed code.
